hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty"); case "$f" in */web/furniture-store/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; app="${f%%/web/furniture-store/*}/web/furniture-store"; p="$app/node_modules/.bin/prettier"; [ -x "$p" ] || exit 0; cd "$app" && "$p" --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
